items.title: Adaptive Theme
items.description: Automatic light/dark theme switching based on system settings, with dynamic accent color extraction.

items.title: Global Streak and Flame Animation
items.description: Introduced the global streak panel with flame animation.

items.title: Weekly Progress Chart
items.description: Added real-time visualization of global streak and weekly progress.

items.title: Today's habits section
items.description: A convenient section for displaying today's habits.

items.title: Detailed statistics
items.description: Stuff statistics for this week, last week, prime week, this month, and last month.

items.title: Export & Import Data
items.description: Import/export your data. Also, preview what exactly will be imported.

items.title: Notifications
items.description: Habit reminders, motivational notifications, and streak alerts

items.title: Lifestyle
items.description: Custom habit categories with unique name validation. Create goal-based plans (e.g., 30 times in 30 days) and track completion separately from daily streaks.

items.title: Lifestyle Dashboard
items.description: Category-level stats: monthly goal with circular progress, weekly completions, habit overview (total habits / completed today), creation date, status badge, and delete with archive warning.

items.title: Habit
items.description: 6-step form with full customization: name, icon & color, description, Lifestyle category, frequency (daily/weekdays/weekends/custom), and time of day with optional specific time (e.g., morning + 08:00).

items.title: Habit Details Panel
items.description: Detailed habit management: current/best streak, weekly progress, activity heatmap, schedule info, creation/last updated dates, and delete confirmation.

items.title: Quests
items.description: Time-limited challenges (not habits, not tasks). Set name, description, icon, color, duration (1–365 days), and start date. Track progress day by day.
